Class TelemetryTable

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable
public final class TelemetryTable extends Object
Telemetry sends information from the robot program to dashboards, debug tools, or log files.

For more advanced use cases, use the NetworkTables or DataLog APIs.

    • log

      public <T> void log(String name, T value)
      Logs a generic object.

      For non-null values, the value is dispatched in this order: TelemetryLoggable, StructSerializable, ProtobufSerializable, boxed primitive and string types, and finally handlers registered with TelemetryRegistry.registerTypeHandler(Class, TelemetryRegistry.TypeHandler). TelemetryLoggable values are logged to a child table named name. Struct and protobuf serializable values are logged with their public static struct or proto serializers. Boolean, Float, Double, Byte, Short, Integer, Long, other Number values, and String are logged as primitive or string entries. Generic Number values other than boxed integral types are logged as double entries. If no registered handler matches, the value falls back to being logged as a string using Object.toString(). Collection values must be logged with an explicit element type.

      Type Parameters:
      T - data type
      Parameters:
      name - the name
      value - the value; must be non-null

      public void log(String name, Collection<?> value) throws CollectionElementTypeRequiredException
      Rejects logging a collection without an explicit element type.

      Use log(String, Collection, Class) or log(String, Collection, Struct) instead.

      Parameters:
      name - the name
      value - the value
      Throws:
      CollectionElementTypeRequiredException - always

    • log

      public void log(String name, Collection<?> value, Class<?> elementType)
      Logs a collection with an explicit element type.

      The element type selects the backend representation. Byte element types are logged as raw byte arrays. Boolean, Float, Double, and String element types are logged like arrays of the same element type. Number and other non-integral number element types are logged as double arrays. Short, Integer, and Long element types are logged as integer arrays. StructSerializable element types are logged with their public static struct serializer. Other element types fall back to string arrays using Object.toString().

      Parameters:
      name - the name
      value - the value
      elementType - the collection element type
